calls.summary: Marcus Bellamy called to check availability at his new address and sign up for 1 Gig Fiber Internet at the $50 promo rate with the 5-year price lock. Oscar confirmed his address was serviceable and walked him through Auto Pay and Paperless Billing savings. Marcus booked a fiber installation appointment for the following week.

Priya Nandakumar wanted to bundle 1 Gig Fiber with Unlimited Mobile and Entertainment TV to earn the $200 prepaid card. Lila built the bundle, explained the mobile per-line pricing, and confirmed the up to $30 monthly savings. Priya scheduled her installation appointment on the call.

Denise Okafor asked about 2 Gig Fiber Internet for a work-from-home household with heavy streaming. Rosey compared the 1 Gig and 2 Gig plans and added Whole Home WiFi as a $5 add-on. Denise agreed and set up her fiber installation appointment.

Anthony Rivera, a new customer switching from Verizon, called to schedule fiber service at his address. Lee collected his full name, service address, contact details, and preferred plan, then quoted the 500 Mbps Fiber plan with the price lock. Anthony confirmed and booked his installation appointment for early next week.

Grace Liang wanted to add two Unlimited Mobile lines to her existing Optimum account under the buy two, get one promotion. Mary explained the multi-line pricing and the trade-in credit toward a new iPhone. Grace decided to also bundle service and scheduled a technician installation appointment.

Curtis Hammond asked about the $25 promotional 1 Gig Fiber deal he saw advertised. Sue confirmed the promo required Auto Pay and included a $50 reward card, then verified his address for fiber coverage. Curtis signed up and reserved an installation appointment.

Yvonne Castellano called for a status update on her pending fiber order after receiving a confirmation email. Mike located her account and confirmed the technician window was still on track. She was satisfied with the update but did not need any changes.

Raymond Delgado disputed a billing charge after his promo rate stepped up sooner than expected. Jennifer reviewed his statement, explained the term-based increase, and applied a one-time courtesy credit. Raymond remained frustrated about the billing surprise but accepted the resolution.

Tara Whitfield called about a mobile device issue after her new phone stopped connecting to the 5G network. Rose ran troubleshooting steps and opened a warranty repair ticket for the mobile handset. Tara was relieved but annoyed at the time it took.

Devin Marsh reported that his scheduled fiber installation was missed by the technician. Mike apologized, confirmed the crew had been delayed, and rebooked the existing installation appointment. Devin was unhappy about taking another day off work.

Olivia Prentice questioned a billing error where a Total Care add-on she never requested appeared on her statement. Lila removed the add-on and issued a refund for two months. Olivia stayed skeptical about future billing accuracy.

Gregory Sun called to cancel his TV package because he felt the Entertainment TV price step-up was too high. Oscar tried to retain him with a Sports Package discount but Gregory chose to cancel the TV portion of his service. He kept his internet only.

Bianca Ferraro filed a complaint about repeated internet outages over the past week. Lee ran a line test, confirmed intermittent signal, and escalated to network engineering. Bianca was very dissatisfied and demanded a service credit.

Nathan Coles called after business hours about a mobile activation problem and reached the after-hours line. The call rolled to voicemail and no agent was available. He left a message requesting a callback about his mobile line.

Sharon Delacroix called to cancel her entire account after a dispute over an early termination fee. Jennifer explained there was no contract but Sharon remained upset about a prorated charge. She insisted on cancel processing and ended the call frustrated.

prompts.question: Is the customer trying to solve a specific problem?
prompts.answer: The caller is relocating to a new home and needs to establish internet service at the new address. They are a new customer to Optimum and interested in reliable fiber connectivity with promotional pricing.

prompts.question: What are the customer's expectations?
prompts.answer: The caller expects a straightforward appointment booking process, wants confirmation of the 1 Gig speed tier, and needs the installation scheduled within the next two weeks to coincide with their move-in date.

prompts.question: How could the agent handle the call better?
prompts.answer: The agent should have captured the customer's email address for appointment confirmation and follow-up communications. Additionally, explaining the technician arrival window and what to prepare for the installation day would have set clearer expectations and reduced future support contacts.

transcript.text: Thank you for calling Optimum. My name is Marcus Bell. May I have your name please?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Hi Marcus. I am Robert Chambers.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Great Robert, I appreciate you calling today. I see you are inquiring about fiber internet service. Are you looking to set up a new account with us?

transcript.text: Yes, I am moving to a new place in about two weeks and I need internet service. I heard about your 1 Gig plan and the pricing promotion.

transcript.text: Excellent. Let me pull up your new address. What is the ZIP code for your new home?

transcript.text: It is 10514, in Harrison, New York.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Perfect, I am confirming that our fiber service is available at that address. You are all set for installation. The 1 Gig Fiber plan is indeed available at that location. Can I get the complete street address as well?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Sure, it is 247 Westchester Avenue, Harrison, New York 10514.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thank you Robert. And what is the best phone number to reach you during business hours?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: You can reach me at ****9847.

transcript.text: Great. I have recorded your phone number. Now, for our 1 Gig Fiber plan, the promotional rate is 25 dollars per month for the first 12 months with our five-year price lock guarantee. After that, the rate adjusts to standard pricing. Does that work for you?

transcript.text: That sounds perfect. When can you get someone out to install?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: We can schedule your installation for a weekday between 8 AM and 5 PM. What date works best for you? I have openings next Tuesday, October 29th, or the following Wednesday, October 30th.

callDetail.aiSummary: Robert Chambers, a new customer relocating to Harrison, New York, called to establish Optimum Fiber Internet service at his new residential address. Marcus Bell successfully verified service availability, confirmed the 1 Gig Fiber plan at the promotional rate of $25 per month with a five-year price lock, and scheduled an installation appointment for Tuesday, October 29th. The call was completed efficiently with proper greeting and close, though the agent did not capture the customer's email address for appointment confirmation communications.

comment.author: Kyle Paklaian
comment.text: @Marcus, excellent job structuring this intake call. Your greeting was professional, you confirmed address availability promptly, and you locked in the appointment date without delays. Two coaching points for next time, please capture the customer's email address in addition to the phone number so we can send a confirmation email with the technician details and move-in checklist. Also, take 10 more seconds to explain what Robert should expect on installation day, such as what equipment the technician will bring and how long he should plan to be home. These details reduce appointment no-shows and follow-up support calls.

qaPairs.question: What internet speeds does Optimum offer?
qaPairs.answer: Optimum Fiber offers symmetrical speeds from 300 Mbps up to 8 Gig, all with a 5-year price lock and no contract. I can help you pick the right tier and set up an installation appointment.

qaPairs.question: How much is the 1 Gig plan?
qaPairs.answer: Pricing varies by address and current promotions, and some offers include a prepaid reward card. Let me confirm your ZIP and book a quick session with a specialist for your exact rate.

qaPairs.question: Do you offer a price lock?
qaPairs.answer: Yes, all Optimum Fiber Internet plans come with a 5-year price lock and no annual contract. I'd be glad to schedule an appointment to get you set up.

qaPairs.question: Can I bundle Internet, Mobile, and TV?
qaPairs.answer: Yes, bundling Fiber with Mobile and Entertainment TV can save you money and may earn a prepaid card. Let's confirm availability at your address and book your installation.

qaPairs.question: What is included with Optimum Mobile?
qaPairs.answer: Optimum Mobile offers Unlimited, Unlimited Max, and Tablet lines on nationwide 5G with talk, text, and data. I can review options and help you get started with an appointment.

qaPairs.question: Do you have a student discount?
qaPairs.answer: Yes, students and educators with a .edu address can qualify for added monthly savings. I can confirm the details and set up an appointment for you.

qaPairs.question: What TV options are available?
qaPairs.answer: Entertainment TV bundles sports, movies, and more, with add-ons like Premium Channels, Sports Packages, and International Channels. Let's confirm your address and book a session to finalize it.

qaPairs.question: Is Whole Home WiFi available?
qaPairs.answer: Yes, Whole Home WiFi is an add-on that extends coverage across your home. I can include it in your setup when we book your installation appointment.

qaPairs.question: How do I check if Optimum is available at my address?
qaPairs.answer: I just need your service address ZIP code to confirm availability. Once confirmed, I can book your installation appointment right away.

qaPairs.question: Can I bring my own phone?
qaPairs.answer: Yes, Optimum Mobile supports bring-your-own-device along with financing and trade-in options. Let's set up an appointment to review what works best for you.

qaPairs.question: What is Advanced Security?
qaPairs.answer: Advanced Security is a network-level add-on that protects your connected devices from threats. I can add it when we schedule your installation.

qaPairs.question: Do you offer trade-in credits for phones?
qaPairs.answer: Yes, select trade-ins on the Unlimited Max plan can earn up to $1,200 back. Let's confirm eligibility and book a specialist session for exact credits.

qaPairs.question: How fast can I get installed?
qaPairs.answer: Installation timing depends on your area and schedule availability. Share your ZIP and preferred day, and I'll set up your installation appointment.

qaPairs.question: Is there a contract?
qaPairs.answer: No, Optimum Fiber plans have no annual contract and include a 5-year price lock. I'd be happy to book your installation to get you connected.

qaPairs.question: What is Total Care?
qaPairs.answer: Total Care is an add-on offering tech support and device protection. I can include it when we schedule your appointment.

qaPairs.question: Do you have a moving offer?
qaPairs.answer: Yes, existing customers who move may qualify for a moving gift and can transfer service. Let me confirm your new ZIP and book your installation.

qaPairs.question: What is the difference between 2 Gig and 8 Gig?
qaPairs.answer: Both are ultra-fast symmetrical fiber, with 8 Gig built for power users running many heavy devices at once. Let's confirm availability and book a session to match you to the right tier.

qaPairs.question: Can I get a prepaid card offer?
qaPairs.answer: Yes, some promotions include prepaid reward cards, especially when bundling. I can confirm current offers for your address and book your installation.

qaPairs.question: Does Optimum work for gaming and work from home?
qaPairs.answer: Yes, symmetrical fiber speeds are great for gaming, streaming, and video calls. Let's confirm your ZIP and book an appointment to get you set up.

qaPairs.question: How do I get started?
qaPairs.answer: I just need a few quick details and your ZIP code to confirm availability. Then I can book your in-home installation appointment with a reminder text beforehand.
